examples.input: 把这个博物馆效果图制作成黄昏动画，保持建筑体量不变，镜头缓慢推进，室内增加暖光
examples.positive_prompt: Architectural visualization of museum, slow push in shot with 35mm lens, twilight dusk illumination, 3500K warm interior glow, preserve building geometry, monumental architectural museum facade
examples.negative_prompt: warped building geometry, melted columns, flickering glass facade, artifacting

examples.negative_prompt: warped geometry, flickering window frames, low resolution
